zh: 先看黃點（帶雜訊的 10 個樣本）散在綠色平滑曲線上下，再看紅色虛線折線把每個點都穿過去：它背熟了雜訊，不是學到規律。折線僅作教學示意，不是網路訓練結果。〔功能：1、2〕
同一批帶雜訊的樣本與平滑規律；折線僅作教學示意，不是網路訓練結果。
en: First see the yellow dots (10 noisy samples) scattered around the smooth green curve, then see the red dashed polyline pass through every point: it memorized the noise instead of learning the pattern. The polyline is only a teaching illustration, not a trained network. [Function: 1, 2]
The same noisy samples and the smooth trend; the polyline is only a teaching illustration, not a network training result.

zh: 先看左邊三層網路，再看中間的計算：隱藏層 (2+1)×3=9、輸出層 (3+1)×1=4，合計 13；右側是自由參數、欠擬合、過擬合的定義。〔功能：2〕
2-3-1 網路的自由參數：隱藏層 9 個、輸出層 4 個，共 13 個。
en: First see the three-layer network on the left, then the calculation in the middle: hidden layer (2+1)×3=9, output layer (3+1)×1=4, total 13; the right side defines free parameter, underfitting and overfitting. [Function: 2]
Free parameters of a 2-3-1 network: 9 in the hidden layer, 4 in the output layer, 13 in all.

zh: 先看藍線（訓練損失）一路下降，再看橘線（驗證損失）在第 3 輪最低後回升；虛線標出要保存的第 3 輪。右側是驗證集、過度訓練、早停的定義。〔功能：2〕
五個檢查點的訓練與驗證平均損失；驗證最低在第 3 輪，訓練最低在第 5 輪。
en: First see the blue line (training loss) fall all the way, then the orange line (validation loss) bottom out at epoch 3 and rise again; the dashed line marks epoch 3, the one to keep. The right side defines validation set, overtraining and early stopping. [Function: 2]
Average training and validation loss at five checkpoints; validation is lowest at epoch 3 and training at epoch 5.

zh: 比較三欄：各個資料集用來做什麼、不能拿來做什麼；下方是小樣本的粗略數字：錯 1 筆 0.1、錯 2 筆 0.2。〔功能：2〕
訓練集、驗證集、測試集各自的用途與限制。
en: Compare the three columns: what each data set is for and what it must not be used for; below are the coarse small-sample numbers: one error 0.1, two errors 0.2. [Function: 2]
The use and limits of the training, validation and test sets.

zh: 先看橫軸的超平面數 K，再比較不同輸入維度 d 的曲線：維度越高、線越多，最大區域數增加越快；右側是公式與 d=1 到 3、K=1 到 4 的數值表。〔功能：2〕
不同輸入維度 d 下，K 個一般位置超平面形成區域數的最大值。
en: First see the number of hyperplanes K on the horizontal axis, then compare the curves for different input dimensions d: the higher the dimension and the more lines, the faster the maximum number of regions grows; the right side shows the formula and the value table for d = 1 to 3 and K = 1 to 4. [Function: 2]
The maximum number of regions formed by K hyperplanes in general position at different input dimensions d.

zh: 先看左圖：兩條平行線 x₁+x₂=0.5 與 1.5 把平面切成三條帶，兩個 A 點在中間帶、兩個 B 點在兩側帶；右邊列出四個點的 x₁+x₂。四塊上界容得下三塊只是容量檢查，要靠這個明確構造證明。〔功能：3〕
XOR 的明確構造：兩條平行線切出三條帶，A 點在中間帶。
en: First see the left chart: the parallel lines x1+x2=0.5 and 1.5 cut the plane into three bands, with the two A points in the middle band and the two B points in the outer bands; the right lists x1+x2 at the four points. That the 4-region bound holds three is only a capacity check; the explicit construction is the proof. [Function: 3]
The explicit XOR construction: two parallel lines cut three bands with the A points in the middle one.

zh: 逐欄比較三種策略：解析法、剪枝、構造式方法；底下一條提醒三條路都要用驗證資料檢查。〔功能：2〕
三種選大小的策略：解析法、剪枝、構造式方法。
en: Compare the three strategies column by column: analytic methods, pruning, constructive methods; the bar below reminds that all three routes need validation data. [Function: 2]
Three strategies for choosing a size: analytic methods, pruning and constructive methods.

zh: 先看左邊的設定：目標 y=sin(2πx)+ε、15 個訓練點、10 個測試點、模型有 3k+1 個參數；再看右邊 k=3、5、15 的參數數 10、16、46 與來源的描述。這不是通用最佳值，本教材沒有重跑。〔功能：1〕
來源正弦示範的設定與 k=3、5、15 的參數數 10、16、46。
en: First see the setup on the left: target y=sin(2πx)+ε, 15 training points, 10 test points and a model with 3k+1 parameters; then see the parameter counts 10, 16 and 46 for k=3, 5, 15 on the right with the source's description. This is not a universal best value and was not rerun here. [Function: 1]
The source's sine-demo setup and the parameter counts 10, 16, 46 for k=3, 5, 15.

zh: 左邊是區域數的遞迴 R(K,d)=R(K−1,d)+R(K−1,d−1) 與驗算 R(3,2)=4+3=7；右上是均方誤差例子，右下是選檢查點的 Python 片段。〔功能：2〕
區域數遞迴與 R(3,2)=7 的驗算、均方誤差例子與選檢查點的程式。
en: The left shows the region recursion R(K,d)=R(K−1,d)+R(K−1,d−1) and the check R(3,2)=4+3=7; top right is the mean-squared-error example and bottom right the Python snippet that selects a checkpoint. [Function: 2]
The region recursion with the check R(3,2)=7, the mean-squared-error example and the checkpoint-selection code.

zh: 由左到右看兩個框：選第 2 輪、算 1+3+3=7、三線平行只有四條帶。〔功能：3〕
兩題練習的解題示範。
en: Read the two boxes from left to right: keep epoch 2; compute 1+3+3=7, and three parallel lines give only four bands. [Function: 3]
Worked answers to the two exercises.
